mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, c.name AS customer_name, b.bill_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM scm_rebate r JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = r.bill_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scm_rebate_tier WHERE rebate_id = #{rebateId} ORDER BY min_amount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_rebate_tier (rebate_id, min_amount, rate) VALUES (#{rebateId}, #{t.minAmount}, #{t.rate})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALES_RETURN' THEN -total_amount ELSE total_amount END), 0) FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE partner_id = #{customerId} AND kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rebate_amount), 0) FROM scm_rebate WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'SETTLED' AND settle_mode = 'NEXT_ORDER'
